about: Example library categories. Each category's 'description' is what new items are matched against (by meaning, no LLM); 'guide' tells an agent how to choose inside the shelf. 'skills' and 'repos' pin known skill titles and starred repos to a shelf; anything not listed is filed automatically and flagged as auto. 'hidden' lists duplicate or legacy skills to keep out of search. Edit freely, deploy, then POST /api/v1/library/categories/apply.
